question: What is the department name of the students with lowest gpa belongs to?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.dept_name FROM student AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_code  =  T2.dept_code ORDER BY stu_gpa LIMIT 1

question: Find the minimum salary for the departments whose average salary is above the average payment of all instructors.
reference_sql: SELECT min(salary) ,  dept_name FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING avg(salary)  >  (SELECT avg(salary) FROM instructor)

question: What is the status code, mobile phone number and email address of customer with last name as Kohler or first name as Marina?
reference_sql: SELECT customer_status_code ,  cell_mobile_phone_number ,  email_address FROM Customers WHERE first_name = "Marina" OR last_name  =  "Kohler"

question: list in alphabetic order all course names and their instructors' names in year 2008.
reference_sql: SELECT T1.title ,  T3.name FROM course AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id JOIN instructor AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.id WHERE YEAR  =  2008 ORDER BY T1.title

question: What is the title, credit value, and department name for courses with more than one prerequisite?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.title ,  T1.credits , T1.dept_name FROM course AS T1 JOIN prereq AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id HAVING count(*)  >  1

question: What are the names and descriptions of the photos taken at the tourist attraction "film festival"?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Description FROM PHOTOS AS T1 JOIN TOURIST_ATTRACTIONS AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID WHERE T2.Name  =  "film festival"

question: How many students are in each department?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  dept_name FROM student GROUP BY dept_name

question: Find courses that ran in Fall 2009 but not in Spring 2010.
reference_sql: SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Fall' AND YEAR  =  2009 EXCEPT SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Spring' AND YEAR  =  2010

question: What are the building, room number, semester and year of courses in the Psychology department, sorted using course title?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.building ,  T2.room_number ,  T2.semester ,  T2.year FROM course AS T1 JOIN SECTION AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id WHERE T1.dept_name  =  'Psychology' ORDER BY T1.title

question: What is the response received date for the document described as Regular that was granted more than 100 dollars?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.response_received_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Document_Types AS T2 ON T1.document_type_code  =  T2.document_type_code JOIN Grants AS T3 ON T1.grant_id  =  T3.grant_id WHERE T2.document_description  =  'Regular' OR T3.grant_amount  >  100

question: What are the different locations of the school with the code BUS?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT dept_address) FROM department WHERE school_code  =  'BUS'

question: Find the names of all the tracks that contain the word "you".
reference_sql: SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Name LIKE '%you%'

question: What are the price ranges of five star hotels?
reference_sql: SELECT price_range FROM HOTELS WHERE star_rating_code  =  "5"

question: What is the id and last name of the driver who participated in the most races after 2010?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.driverid ,  T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverid  =  T2.driverid JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE T3.year > 2010 GROUP BY T1.driverid ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of all music genres.
reference_sql: SELECT Name FROM GENRE

question: How many professors are teaching class with code ACCT-211?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT PROF_NUM) FROM CLASS WHERE CRS_CODE  =  "ACCT-211"

question: List the names of all the distinct customers who bought a keyboard.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN customer_orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id JOIN products AS T4 ON T3.product_id  =  T4.product_id WHERE T4.product_name  =  "keyboard"

question: How many different locations does each school have?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT dept_address) ,  school_code FROM department GROUP BY school_code

question: What are the titles of courses without prerequisites?

question: List phone number and email address of customer with more than 2000 outstanding balance.

question: How many classrooms are not in Lamberton?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM classroom WHERE building != 'Lamberton'

question: Which employee manage most number of peoples? List employee's first and last name, and number of people report to that employee.
reference_sql: SELECT T2.first_name , T2.last_name ,  count(T1.reports_to) FROM employees AS T1 JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.reports_to = T2.id GROUP BY T1.reports_to ORDER BY count(T1.reports_to) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List all vehicle id
reference_sql: SELECT vehicle_id FROM Vehicles;

question: For each customer status code, how many customers are classified that way?
reference_sql: SELECT customer_status_code , count(*) FROM Customers GROUP BY customer_status_code;

question: Which artist has the most albums?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId  =  T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the number of routes and airport name for each source airport, order the results by decreasing number of routes.
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  T1.name FROM airports AS T1 JOIN routes AS T2 ON T1.apid  =  T2.src_apid GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

question: Find the average unit price for a track.
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK

question: Find the names and average salaries of all departments whose average salary is greater than 42000.

question: What are the duration of the longest and shortest pop tracks in milliseconds?
reference_sql: SELECT max(Milliseconds) ,  min(Milliseconds) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId  =  T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Name  =  "Pop"

question: What are the names of all the playlists?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM playlists;

question: What is the name of the department with the student that has the lowest GPA?

question: Find names of instructors with salary greater than that of some (at least one) instructor in the Biology department.

reference_sql: SELECT star_rating_code ,  avg(price_range) FROM HOTELS GROUP BY star_rating_code

question: Find the distinct driver id of all drivers that have a longer stop duration than some drivers in the race whose id is 841?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT driverid ,  STOP FROM pitstops WHERE duration  >  (SELECT min(duration) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid  =  841)

question: List top 10 employee work longest in the company. List employee's first and last name.
reference_sql: SELECT first_name , last_name FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date ASC LIMIT 10;

question: List the description of the outcomes for all projects.

question: What are the order ids and customer ids for orders that have been Cancelled, sorted by their order dates?

question: What is the title of the course with Differential Geometry as a prerequisite?
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM course WHERE course_id IN (SELECT T1.course_id FROM prereq AS T1 JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.prereq_id  =  T2.course_id WHERE T2.title  =  'Differential Geometry')

question: Find the maximum and minimum millisecond lengths of pop tracks.
reference_sql: SELECT max(Milliseconds) ,  min(Milliseconds) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId  =  T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Name  =  "Pop"

question: What is the count and code of the job with the most employee?
reference_sql: SELECT emp_jobcode ,  count(*) FROM employee GROUP BY emp_jobcode ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the first and last names of all the employees and how many people report to them?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.first_name , T2.last_name ,  count(T1.reports_to) FROM employees AS T1 JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.reports_to = T2.id GROUP BY T1.reports_to ORDER BY count(T1.reports_to) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Return the distinct name of customers whose order status is Pending, in the order of customer id.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN customer_orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id WHERE T2.order_status_code  =  "Pending" ORDER BY T2.customer_id

question: How many routes go from the United States to Canada?

question: What are the names and genders of staff who have held the title Sales Person, but never Clerical Staff?

question: What is the average weight of all players?

question: What is detail of the student who most recently registered course?

question: Show the names of all the employees with role "HR".

question: Find the name of the instructors who taught C Programming course before.

question: How many orders does Luca Mancini have in his invoices?

question: What is the id and detail of the vehicle used in lessons for most of the times?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.vehicle_id ,  T1.vehicle_details FROM Vehicles AS T1 JOIN Lessons AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id GROUP BY T1.vehicle_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the names and average salaries for departments with average salary higher than 42000?
reference_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  AVG (salary) FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING AVG (salary)  >  42000

question: What is the id of the candidate whose email is stanley.monahan@example.org?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.candidate_id FROM people AS T1 JOIN candidates AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.candidate_id WHERE T1.email_address = "stanley.monahan@example.org"

question: Return the cities with more than 3 airports in the United States.
reference_sql: SELECT city FROM airports WHERE country  =  'United States' GROUP BY city HAVING count(*)  >  3

question: What are the names of all races that occurred after 12:00:00 or before 09:00:00?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM races WHERE TIME > "12:00:00" OR TIME < "09:00:00"

question: List the names and phone numbers of all the distinct suppliers who supply red jeans.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.supplier_name ,  T1.supplier_phone FROM suppliers AS T1 JOIN product_suppliers AS T2 ON T1.supplier_id  =  T2.supplier_id JOIN products AS T3 ON T2.product_id  =  T3.product_id WHERE T3.product_name  =  "red jeans"

question: What are the names of all races held between 2009 and 2011?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM races WHERE YEAR BETWEEN 2009 AND 2011

question: Show different tourist attractions' names, ids, and the corresponding number of visits.
reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID ,   COUNT(*) FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN VISITS AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID

question: What are the last names of customers without invoice totals exceeding 20?
reference_sql: SELECT LastName FROM CUSTOMER EXCEPT SELECT T1.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId  =  T2.CustomerId WHERE T2.total  >  20

question: What roles did staff members play between '2003-04-19 15:06:20' and '2016-03-15 00:33:18'?
reference_sql: SELECT role_code FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_from  >  '2003-04-19 15:06:20' AND date_to  <  '2016-03-15 00:33:18'

question: What are the countries of all airlines whose names start with Orbit?
reference_sql: SELECT country FROM airlines WHERE name LIKE 'Orbit%'

question: What are all details of the students who registered but did not attend any course?
reference_sql: SELECT * FROM student_course_registrations WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM student_course_attendance)

question: Which city does staff with first name as Janessa and last name as Sawayn live?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.city FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Staff AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.staff_address_id WHERE T2.first_name = "Janessa" AND T2.last_name = "Sawayn";

question: What are the task details, task ids, and project ids for the progrects that are detailed as 'omnis' or have at least 3 outcomes?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.task_details ,  T1.task_id ,  T2.project_id FROM Tasks AS T1 JOIN Projects AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id WHERE T2.project_details  =  'omnis' UNION SELECT T1.task_details ,  T1.task_id ,  T2.project_id FROM Tasks AS T1 JOIN Projects AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id JOIN Project_outcomes AS T3 ON T2.project_id  =  T3.project_id GROUP BY T2.project_id HAVING count(*)  >  2

question: What are the forenames and surnames of drivers who participated in the races named Australian Grand Prix but not the races named Chinese Grand Prix?
reference_sql: SELECT T3.forename ,  T3.surname FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid = T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Australian Grand Prix" EXCEPT SELECT T3.forename ,  T3.surname FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid = T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Chinese Grand Prix"

question: What are the names and type codes of products?
reference_sql: SELECT Product_Name ,  Product_Type_Code FROM Products

question: What is the number of airports per country, ordered from most to least?

question: What is the department name and corresponding building for the department with the greatest budget?
reference_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  building FROM department ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many students are enrolled in the class taught by some professor from the accounting department?

reference_sql: SELECT dept_name FROM department ORDER BY dept_name

reference_sql: SELECT payment_method_code ,  count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY payment_method_code

question: Which school has the fewest professors?
